parameters.jsCode: const h=$json.headers||{};const supplied=h['x-assis-internal-token']||h['X-Assis-Internal-Token'];if(!supplied)throw new Error('unauthorized internal context call');const b=$json.body??$json;return [{json:{body:b,auth_endpoint:'http://n8n:5678/webhook/assis/internal/auth/verify',auth_request:{token:supplied}}}];
if($json.valid!==true)throw new Error('unauthorized internal context call');return [{json:$node['Authorize Context'].json.body}];
const b=$json.body??$json;if(!b.conversation_id) throw new Error('conversation_id required'); return [{json:{conversation_id:b.conversation_id,max_messages:Math.min(b.max_messages??20,50)}}];

parameters.query: SELECT c.id conversation_id,c.organization_id,c.contact_id,c.context,stm.summary,stm.slots,COALESCE(msg.recent_messages,'[]'::jsonb) recent_messages,COALESCE(lt.long_term_memories,'[]'::jsonb) long_term_memories FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN short_term_memory stm ON stm.conversation_id=c.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('direction',m.direction,'type',m.message_type,'body',m.body,'created_at',m.created_at) ORDER BY m.created_at) recent_messages FROM (SELECT direction,message_type,body,created_at FROM messages WHERE conversation_id=c.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT $2) m) msg ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('memory_key',ltm.memory_key,'memory_value',ltm.memory_value,'confidence',ltm.confidence,'expires_at',ltm.expires_at,'updated_at',ltm.updated_at) ORDER BY ltm.updated_at DESC) long_term_memories FROM long_term_memory ltm WHERE ltm.organization_id=c.organization_id AND ltm.contact_id=c.contact_id AND (ltm.expires_at IS NULL OR ltm.expires_at>now())) lt ON true WHERE c.id=$1::uuid;
